)

type mobaGetter map[int64]entity.IThreadSafeEntity

func (g mobaGetter) Get(_ context.Context, id int64, _ entity.EntityCategory) (entity.IThreadSafeEntity, error) {
	if e := g[id]; e != nil {
		return e, nil
	}
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown entity %d", id)
}
func (g mobaGetter) GetMany(ctx context.Context, ids []int64, cats []entity.EntityCategory) ([]entity.IThreadSafeEntity, error) {
	out := make([]entity.IThreadSafeEntity, len(ids))
	for i, id := range ids {
		v, err := g.Get(ctx, id, cats[i])
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		out[i] = v
	}
	return out, nil
}

// 替身只替换提交器；不宣称这些用例验证 WAL fsync 或 Mongo，真实持久化有独立框架验收入口。
type mobaCommitter struct{}

func (mobaCommitter) Commit(context.Context, dataengine.CommitRecord) error { return nil }

type mobaFixture struct {
	engine  *nest.NestMgr
	players [2]*player.Player
	result  *resultentity.MatchResult
}

func newMOBAFixture(t *testing.T) *mobaFixture {
	t.Helper()
	player.RegisterEntity()
	resultentity.RegisterEntity()
	RegisterMobaSettlementNestHandlers()
	f := &mobaFixture{}
	g := mobaGetter{}
	for i := range 2 {
		id, _ := entity.BuildEntityID(int64(900+i), player.EntityKindPlayer)
		built, err := entity.BuildEntity(&entity.EntityCreateParam{IsCreate: true, Id: id, Kind: player.EntityKindPlayer})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		f.players[i] = built.(*player.Player)
		g[id] = built
	}
	id, _ := entity.BuildEntityID(1, resultentity.EntityKindMatchResult)
	built, err := entity.BuildEntity(&entity.EntityCreateParam{IsCreate: true, Id: id, Kind: resultentity.EntityKindMatchResult})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	f.result = built.(*resultentity.MatchResult)
	g[id] = built
	f.engine = nest.NewEngine(nest.NestOptionWithGetter(g), nest.NestOptionWithTransactionCommitter(mobaCommitter{}), nest.NestOptionWithWorkerPools(nest.WorkerPoolConfig{Workers: 2, QueueCap: 32}, nest.WorkerPoolConfig{}, nest.WorkerPoolConfig{}))
	if err := f.engine.Start(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = f.engine.Shutdown(context.Background()) })
	return f
}
func TestMOBASettlementConcurrentReplayAndIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	f := newMOBAFixture(t)
	s := sender.NewMobaSettlementSender(f.engine)
	ctx := context.Background()
	digest := strings.Repeat("a", 64)
	r, a, b := f.result.ID(), f.players[0].ID(), f.players[1].ID()
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	errs := make([]error, 8)
	for i := range errs {
		wg.Add(1)
		go func(i int) {
			defer wg.Done()
			errs[i] = s.MultiSync_MOBASettle(ctx, r, a, b, "ranked-match-1", digest, false)
		}(i)
	}
	wg.Wait()
	for _, err := range errs {
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	if f.players[0].Dao().GetGold() != 10 || f.players[0].Dao().GetWins() != 1 || f.players[1].Dao().GetLosses() != 1 {
		t.Fatal("one result paid / counted more than once")
	}
	if err := s.MultiSync_MOBASettle(ctx, r, b, a, "ranked-match-1", digest, false); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("changed winner accepted")
	}
	if err := s.MultiSync_MOBASettle(ctx, r, a, b, "ranked-match-2", digest, false); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("result identity reused for another match")
	}
	if err := s.MultiSync_MOBASettle(ctx, r, a, b, "ranked-match-1", strings.Repeat("b", 64), false); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("changed reference digest accepted")
	}
}
func TestMOBASettlementRollbackAndRetry(t *testing.T) {
	f := newMOBAFixture(t)
	ctx := context.Background()
	failed := errors.New("injected refusal after settlement")
	name := nest.NewHandlerName("moba_settlement_refused")
	nest.MustRegisterHandlerWithMeta(name, func(es []entity.IThreadSafeEntity, _ []any, _ ...nest.HandlerOption) (any, error) {
		if err := handlerMOBASettle(es[0].(IMobaResultEntity), es[1].(IMobaPlayerEntity), es[2].(IMobaPlayerEntity), "match", strings.Repeat("a", 64), false); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return nil, failed
	}, nest.HandlerMeta{Rollback: nest.RollbackUndo, Durability: nest.DurabilityStrict})
	if _, err := f.engine.RequestMulti(ctx, name, []int64{f.result.ID(), f.players[0].ID(), f.players[1].ID()}, nil); !errors.Is(err, failed) {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if f.result.Dao().GetStatus() != 0 || f.players[0].Dao().GetGold() != 0 || f.players[0].Dao().GetWins() != 0 || f.players[1].Dao().GetLosses() != 0 {
		t.Fatal("partial settlement survived rejection")
	}
	if err := sender.NewMobaSettlementSender(f.engine).MultiSync_MOBASettle(ctx, f.result.ID(), f.players[0].ID(), f.players[1].ID(), "match", strings.Repeat("a", 64), false); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
func TestMOBANoWinnerSettlementNeverPays(t *testing.T) {
	f := newMOBAFixture(t)
	s := sender.NewMobaSettlementSender(f.engine)
	ctx := context.Background()
	for range 2 {
		if err := s.MultiSync_MOBASettle(ctx, f.result.ID(), f.players[0].ID(), f.players[1].ID(), "cancelled-match", strings.Repeat("a", 64), true); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	if f.result.Dao().GetStatus() != 2 || f.players[0].Dao().GetGold() != 0 || f.players[0].Dao().GetWins() != 0 || f.players[1].Dao().GetLosses() != 0 {
		t.Fatal("cancelled / unresumable match paid win rewards")
	}
}

// 一个完整样例回合：会话绑定的输入 → 正式 Match → 服务器参考胜负 → 正式多实体 Sender 结算。
func TestMOBAServerReferenceSettlesTheFinishedRound(t *testing.T) {
	f := newMOBAFixture(t)
	ctx := context.Background()
	wire := nettransport.TransportFunc{Datagram: func(context.Context, nettransport.SessionID, []byte) error { return nil }}
	store, err := svcmatch.NewMemoryStore(svcmatch.Config{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	queue := svcmatch.Queue{Mode: "moba", GroupSize: 2, Partition: "local-owner"}
	ticketIDs := []string{}
	for _, p := range f.players {
		ticket, err := store.Enqueue(ctx, queue, svcmatch.Subject{Kind: "player", ID: entity.GetUniqueIDFromEntityID(p.ID())}, fmt.Sprint(p.ID()))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		ticketIDs = append(ticketIDs, ticket.ID)
	}
	matched, err := store.Commit(ctx, queue, ticketIDs)
	if err != nil || len(matched.Members) != 2 {
		t.Fatal("match was not atomically formed")
	}
	room, err := lockstep.NewMatch(lockstep.MatchConfig{Sequencer: lockstep.SequencerConfig{Players: []lockstep.PlayerID{1, 2}, MaxInputBytes: 3}, Datagrams: wire})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer room.Close()
	if err := room.Attach(1, 101); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	reference := moba.NewState()
	for !reference.Ended && reference.Tick < 100 {
		c := moba.Command{}
		h := reference.Heroes[0]
		if h.X < 7 {
			c = moba.Command{Action: moba.Move, Step: 1}
		} else if reference.Towers[1] > 0 {
			c = moba.Command{Action: moba.Attack, Target: moba.TowerTarget}
		} else if h.X < 9 {
			c = moba.Command{Action: moba.Move, Step: 1}
		} else {
			c = moba.Command{Action: moba.Attack, Target: moba.BaseTarget}
		}
		if err := moba.Submit(room, 101, room.NextFrame(), moba.Encode(c)); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		frame, err := room.Tick(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := reference.Apply(frame); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	winner, digest, err := reference.Result()
	if err != nil || winner != 1 {
		t.Fatal("no authoritative win")
	}
	s := sender.NewMobaSettlementSender(f.engine)
	for range 2 {
		if err := s.MultiSync_MOBASettle(ctx, f.result.ID(), f.players[0].ID(), f.players[1].ID(), matched.ID, digest, false); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	if f.result.Dao().GetDigest() != digest || f.players[0].Dao().GetWins() != 1 || f.players[0].Dao().GetGold() != 10 {
		t.Fatal("reference result did not pay exactly once")
	}
}
